speed.interpretation: delta>1 means Rust faster than FFI; it is ffi_min_ns/rust_min_ns from a measurement that alternates the two implementations inside one window, and falls back to rust_bytes_per_sec/ffi_bytes_per_sec from the separate criterion arms when no paired measurement exists
